Class RmiServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.network.rmi.server.RmiServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServerRmi, VirtualServer, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualServerRmi
RMI adapter exposing the controller as a VirtualServerRmi. Every remote call is delegated to the wrapped controller on a cached thread pool so the RMI transport thread stays responsive.

Both the RMI registry and the exported remote object are bound to PORT, so opening that single TCP port on the server firewall is enough to accept inbound RMI traffic.
